description: Return a structured liveness snapshot from the sidecar: uptime, bot_connected, bridge_active, perception_tick_count_last_60s, handler_count, lot_id, last_perception_ts. Pure local read — no IPC, no campfire poll, no file I/O. Answerable even when the bot is wedged.
call_signatures: cf $BODY_CF report-liveness   # returns {sidecar_uptime_sec, bot_connected, bridge_active, perception_tick_count_last_60s, handler_count, lot_id, last_perception_ts}

response_shape.bridge_active: bool — at least one perception tick seen in the last 60s
response_shape.perception_tick_count_last_60s: int — number of perception ticks in the last 60s
response_shape.handler_count: int — number of registered convention handlers
response_shape.lot_id: int — last known lot_id (0 if unknown)
response_shape.last_perception_ts: int — unix ms of last perception (0 if none)
